definitions.explanation: A person who holds an important position in a company, typically a member of the board of directors. Includes positions such as president, vice president, and directors.

examples.japanese: {重役|じゅうやく}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重役|じゅうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めている→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: He serves as an executive at a major corporation.

examples.japanese: {重役|じゅうやく}⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧しか⟦{来|こ}ない→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some people come in only in the afternoon, arriving late like an executive.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重役|じゅうやく}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ (board meeting)
- {重役|じゅうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ (to serve as a director)
- {重役|じゅうやく}⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧ (arriving late for work, lit. "executive arrival")
- {重役|じゅうやく}{室|しつ} (executive office)

USAGE:
The humorous expression {重役|じゅうやく}⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧ literally means "arriving to work like a company executive" (who can come in late), and is used jokingly to describe someone who shows up to work late. This is one of the most recognizable uses of the word in everyday conversation.
